name: paranoid android
author: realm1005
description: Go under the cube portal as the wave at 31% and then shortly after start spamming above the gameplay while near the top of the screen and continue doing so. Move down at 36.5% and then skip the cube portal by holding up between the saw and spike at 37.3%. Navigate through the gameplay while staying as the wave until 43.5% where you can hold above the level. Stay at a constant position above the level's gameplay while not being able to see your icon until the end from there.
